Scope Gate.decided_by: omn-business-analyst subagent a571b7e63bb7c98ac, recorded by session operator for vuhoangcao
Scope Gate.rationale: S-001 to S-018 are bounded by A-001 to A-024, and the five blocking questions are settled here. Q-001: type, title, description and tags come only from existing record fields (a fixed lesson type; kind, check id or gate, and artifact type; the neutralised check description; kind, artifact type and phases), with the exact text set at design. Q-002: generated.by is <producer>/<version> and generated.at is last_seen, which migration keeps, so A-012 holds. Q-003: the architect sets the stale_after rule from record fields only, with no wall clock; "applies to none" is allowed only if justified. Q-004: Z is an explicit UTC offset, so the current form stays. Q-005: render_section shows no timestamp, so A-011 is safe; memory_slice store and store_digest of new envelopes name the bundle, and existing evidence is not rewritten. Carried forward: Q-006 closes at design on SPEC 5.3 and 5.4; A-005 needs a check of generated.at and generated.by; a criterion for the Q-003 rule is added once fixed; lessons with empty history get a deterministic Creation entry in log.md dated from first_seen, never from write time (A-009, A-012); description neutralised as render_section does; A-004 compares on the artifact path without the #E- suffix; Q-007 open for design (omn-qa). omn-product-owner produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding

Planning Gate.decided_by: omn-tech-lead subagent ac059d1a8684013e1, recorded by session operator for vuhoangcao
Planning Gate.rationale: The plan is feasible and well sequenced. T-027 gates T-026, T-014 precedes T-025, and T-032 closes the change set before T-016 and T-029. Rulings: the bundle replaces the store at memory/lessons as index.md, log.md and L-*.md, and the lock file is not a .md file. T-030 and T-034 must scope by relative path: the current name-only installer matcher, and an optimiser that does not deny log.md, would not satisfy R-009. The conformance check is advisory only (X-005, closing Q-002), which keeps F9 verdicts intact. RUNTIME_VERSION moves to 0.11.0 under FR-07, because new envelopes change memory_slice store and store_digest (T-012); the plan omits this, so T-012 owns the change and T-029 must exclude the version string from verdict comparison. Conditions: no implementation task starts before the Design Gate; T-014 runs read-only before the first code edit; lesson-set changes are frozen until T-027 (A-003); T-025, T-026, T-027 and T-013 land as one change (R-011); T-001 uses the supplied SPEC (R-006); A-005 is confirmed as framework-internal. planner produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding

Design Gate.decided_by: omn-tech-lead subagent a4d823ed9c79d02bc, recorded by session operator for vuhoangcao
Design Gate.rationale: O-002 meets every hard constraint, and D-001 to D-006 are accepted (Q-005). Rulings: Q-001 yes, as the design proposes. Q-002: D-004 is accepted, and omn-product-owner records its criterion under T-010. Q-003: both readings are accepted. Q-004: no README row is needed. Q-006: AC-019 excludes the carrying run. A-007 does not hold, so AC-016 counts the live store at the moment of migration; migrate reads that store under the lock and compares it record for record, and the P-003 copy serves only as the parity baseline. The process-actor verified field is left out, because X-004 and scope A-007 forbid it, and it would make document bytes depend on the policy threshold, which breaks C-008. Binding conditions: (1) render_section stays unchanged, and its bytes stay identical over the same lesson set. (2) A second write is byte-identical, log.md included. (3) Tests build temporary roots and never touch the live store. (4) Nothing under runs/ is edited, apart from new evidence the runtime writes itself. (5) P-004 lands before any bundle file exists. (6) The JSON store is removed only by a verified migrate, in one change with T-013. (7) KNOWLEDGE_CHANGE_SET stays frozen. architect produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding

Review Gate.decided_by: omn-qa subagent aa2b26c926605097c, recorded by session operator for vuhoangcao
Review Gate.rationale: Blocking correction CR-001 is closed: migrate treats an existing bundle as authoritative, refuses with migration-mismatch and writes nothing when the bundle holds lessons or records the JSON store lacks or differs on, with tests for both cases. CR-003 is closed and CR-002 stays a non-blocking improvement owned by the architect.
